builds.name: Shadow (PvP / solo)
builds.summary: Shadowform (+10% damage, -50% Shadow mana cost), Silence, Vampiric Embrace, Blackout, Improved Psychic Scream (now requires Blackout 5), Improved Mind Flay, Darkness and Early Demise (Shadow Word: Death exists in Forever), with Twin Disciplines and Silent Resolve replacing the removed Unbreakable Will.

core.why: +10% Shadow damage, -50% Shadow mana cost (demo).
5s silence + 3s interrupt.
Stun procs; now tier 1 and the Improved Psychic Scream prerequisite.
Party healing from Shadow damage (now on a 1-minute cooldown).
Reworked into a self-buff: 33% chance per Shadow spell for +2% Shadow damage, 5 stacks.
+10% Shadow damage.
+10% damage and +5 yards; slows less.
+15%/rank Shadow Word: Death crit below 20% — the execute.
Shorter Mind Blast cooldown.
5% Shadow hit.
-15% duration of stuns, fears and silences on you at 3/3: the only crowd-control reduction left in the Forever priest trees.
+20% absorb on the shield a PvP priest recasts every 15 s; casts are not pushed back while it holds.

alternatives: Twin Disciplines 5
flex.why: Tier-1 Discipline filler.

notes: Shadow raid DPS may finally be viable: Shadow Weaving no longer needs debuff slots, Vampiric Embrace heals the party, and Shadowform halves mana costs. The same 7/0/44 with Shadow Affinity 3 is the raid variant.

2026-09-27 scenario audit: Spirit Tap 5, Improved Shadow Word: Pain 2, Improved Fade 2, Wand Specialization 2 -> Silent Resolve 1, Twin Disciplines 2, Improved Power Word: Shield 3, Inner Focus 1, Martyrdom 2, Meditation 2. Fade only lowers NPC threat, so Improved Fade does nothing against players; Spirit Tap procs only on a kill (one kill ends a duel); a longer Shadow Word: Pain is dispelled or outlasts the fight; wands are not a PvP weapon. The points buy the Discipline half of a PvP shadow priest: Silent Resolve 3/3 (-15% stun, fear and silence duration), Improved Power Word: Shield (+20% absorb; casts are not pushed back while it holds), Inner Focus (a free, +25% crit Mind Blast), Martyrdom and Meditation (PvP profile +8.8 points; the 2026-09-27 priest audit's 11/0/40 direction).
open_questions: Shadow Word: Death baseline availability; Shadowform crit bonus (text truncated in the demo capture).
